te: Study visits in the South and Central regions, and schools' utility costs
se: The committee considered draft programmes for education study visits to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani on 4–6 September 2026, such as the provincial office of the Teachers' Council welfare fund (OTEP), a Chinese language and culture camp and a teachers' savings cooperative, and to Samut Sakhon and Phetchaburi on 17–18 September 2026. It resolved to request information from the Metropolitan Electricity Authority, the Provincial Electricity Authority, the Metropolitan Waterworks Authority and the Provincial Waterworks Authority to study schools' utility costs.
it: Draft programme of the study visit to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani (4–6 September 2026)
Draft programme of the study visit to Samut Sakhon and Phetchaburi (17–18 September 2026)
Requesting information from the electricity and waterworks authorities on schools' utility costs

te: AI training for teachers in Yasothon, and a Chinese language camp in Nakhon Si Thammarat
se: The committee approved a hands-on workshop on using artificial intelligence (AI) to develop teachers and education staff in Yasothon, to help reduce workload and improve teaching, and approved a Chinese language camp on 29–30 August 2026 at Cha-uat School, Nakhon Si Thammarat.
it: Hands-on workshop on using artificial intelligence to develop teachers and education staff, Yasothon
Chinese language camp (29–30 August 2026), Nakhon Si Thammarat

te: Programme for the education study visit to Si Sa Ket, 9–11 July 2026
se: Mr Wiwat Rungkaew, Second Vice-Chair and spokesperson of the committee, presented the programme of the education study visit to Si Sa Ket on 9–11 July 2026, such as visiting schools in Kantharalak District and meeting the provincial education officer, educational service area directors and school leaders.
it: Programme of the education study visit to Si Sa Ket (9–11 July 2026)

te: A bill to transfer state land in Udon Thani, a Si Sa Ket visit and the Andaman International Health Centre
se: The education and vocational education subcommittee reported on its draft report studying the bill to transfer state property land in Dong Yen Subdistrict, Ban Dung District, Udon Thani, under Rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure. The committee approved a study visit on education to Si Sa Ket, and agreed to invite Prince of Songkla University, Phuket Campus, to report progress on the Andaman International Health Centre project to the higher education subcommittee.
it: Draft report on the bill to transfer state property land in Dong Yen Subdistrict, Ban Dung District, Udon Thani (Rule 119)
Study visit on education to Si Sa Ket
Inviting Prince of Songkla University, Phuket Campus, to report on the Andaman International Health Centre

te: Effects of changing the employment of OBEC school staff to temporary employees
se: The committee heard the Minister of Education, the Secretary-General of OBEC and the director of Nakhon Ratchasima Primary Educational Service Area Office 1 on the effects of changing the status of education staff under OBEC from service contract workers to temporary employees, as approved by the government manpower committee, including selection criteria, problems and ways to look after those affected. It also considered how to study the Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi Bill and the Rajamangala University of Technology Bill (No. ..).
it: Effects of changing the employment status of OBEC education staff (Minister of Education, OBEC, Nakhon Ratchasima Primary Educational Service Area Office 1)
How to study the Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi Bill and the Rajamangala University of Technology Bill (No. ..)

te: Support for teachers affected by a violent incident in Pattani
se: The chair reported that after a violent attack near a school in Yarang District, Pattani, on 25 May 2026, in which a local teacher died and the teacher's child was injured, the committee invited the agencies concerned to explain compensation and assistance for teachers and their families. The committee also heard the higher education subcommittee.
it: Compensation and assistance for teachers affected by the incident in Yarang District, Pattani (25 May 2026)
Work of the higher education subcommittee

te: Ten points for the Minister of Higher Education, and the Smart Teacher project
se: The committee considered ten discussion points for its visit to the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, drawn from the subcommittees' reports, such as a national manpower and skills data system, a lifelong learning account, integrated research databases and promoting artificial intelligence courses. It prepared to welcome a delegation from Oxford University Press on 8 June 2026 and heard the work of the working group on developing teachers and education personnel (Smart Teacher).
it: Ten discussion points for the visit to the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation
Preparing to welcome a delegation from Oxford University Press (8 June 2026)
Work of the teacher and education personnel development working group (Smart Teacher)

te: Equal lifelong learning for older people
se: The learning promotion subcommittee reported on its meeting 10/2026 (20 May 2026), including progress by its working group on the draft report “Policy recommendations on promoting equal lifelong learning for older people in Thailand”, and the other subcommittees reported on their ongoing studies.
it: Draft report on promoting equal lifelong learning for older people

te: Preparing talks with the Minister of Education, and a draft report on raising Thai universities in world rankings
se: The committee prepared to visit the Minister of Education to discuss and exchange views on education on Friday 22 May 2026 at the Ministry of Education, and the higher education subcommittee reported progress on its draft report on raising Thai universities in international rankings, now reorganised into six chapters.
it: Preparing talks with the Minister of Education (22 May 2026)
Draft report on raising Thai universities in international rankings (higher education subcommittee)

te: Getting ready for the new curriculum to be used nationwide in 2028
se: The education and vocational education subcommittee reported information from the Institute for the Promotion of Teaching Science and Technology (IPST) and OBEC on developing a curriculum that meets the country's needs, and proposed seven points to prepare before the curriculum is used nationwide in 2028, such as planning the training and development of specialist teachers (STEM and guidance teachers) with universities. The committee approved a study visit by the learning promotion subcommittee on 17–19 June 2026.
it: Seven proposals to prepare for the nationwide use of the new curriculum in 2028
Study visit by the learning promotion subcommittee (17–19 June 2026)

te: Screening children with disabilities in remote areas, student loans, and using research
se: The learning promotion subcommittee reported proposals on community-based early screening and referral of children with disabilities in remote areas (case study: Nan), which found a shortage of special education staff. The committee agreed to set up a working group to develop proposals for screening children with disabilities into the education system together with communities and parents, and noted progress on solving problems with loans from the Student Loan Fund. The higher education subcommittee presented draft proposals on putting medical, health, agricultural and food research to use, such as tax incentives.
it: Early screening and referral of children with disabilities in remote areas (case study: Nan)
Solving problems with student loans (Student Loan Fund)
Proposals on putting medical, health, agricultural and food research to use

te: Education for stateless children, CWIE proposals and a field visit to Si Sa Ket
se: The learning promotion subcommittee reported progress on education for specific groups, such as stateless children and children of migrant workers (case studies in Samut Sakhon and Tak). The higher education subcommittee put forward six main proposals to raise cooperative and work-integrated education (CWIE), such as a national database and a goal for every programme to include CWIE. The committee approved a field visit to Si Sa Ket to study teaching in schools affected by the border situation.
it: Education for stateless children and children of migrant workers
Six policy proposals to raise CWIE
Field visit to Si Sa Ket

te: Preparing talks with the education and higher education ministers, and a working group on the National Education Bill
se: The committee prepared to meet the Minister of Education and the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation to learn their policies, offer support and present proposals in three parts, such as supporting the “give time back to teachers” policy and proposals from the committee's studies. It also considered appointing a working group to study and coordinate information on drafting the National Education Bill B.E. ....
it: Preparing to meet the Minister of Education and the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation
Appointing a working group on drafting the National Education Bill B.E. ....

te: Hearing views on cooperative education and work-integrated learning (CWIE)
se: The higher education subcommittee reported on its meeting 13/2026 (7 April 2026), a focus group with public and private sector bodies to gather views for policy proposals on cooperative and work-integrated education (CWIE).
it: Views on cooperative education and CWIE (higher education subcommittee)

te: Modern secondary school curricula, dual-track education and AI skills
se: The committee heard OBEC's secondary education and academic standards offices on developing secondary school curricula, such as making curriculum upgrading an urgent agenda, linking career planning with the labour market, making dual-track programmes flexible and balanced between academic and vocational study, building civic foundations in lower secondary school, and promoting future skills and artificial intelligence (AI), with budget proposals to reduce inequality.
it: Developing secondary school curricula (OBEC)

te: Helping children and young people who have left school (Thailand Zero Dropout)
se: The committee heard reports from all three subcommittees. The education and vocational education subcommittee reported progress on proposals to help children and young people who have left school, sustainably, through the Thailand Zero Dropout strategy, while the learning promotion and higher education subcommittees reported on their ongoing studies.
it: Proposals to help children and young people who have left school (education and vocational education subcommittee)
Work of the learning promotion and higher education subcommittees
